column1: # Bare `.allow_threads(` sites allowed in the Python transport modules
# scripts/check/python/finalize-guard.sh, which fails on any bare site not
# listed here AND on any row whose site no longer exists.
# Rule: a native call that can park (network I/O, a wait on a channel or a
# deadline, a thread join, or a lock another thread can hold across one,
# e.g. the `Owned` slot a parked recv holds) MUST go through
# `util::allow_threads_parking`, so a thread that wakes after interpreter
# finalisation began parks instead of re-taking the GIL (CPython would
# kill it and the process aborts). Only a call that finishes in bounded
# time on in-memory state may stay bare, with its reason below.
# Columns (TAB-separated): path, function, reason. One row per
